properties.title: Chandrayaan-2 CLASS L2 Elemental Abundance Map - Silicon
properties.lri:data_use_note: Si wt% derived from CLASS X-ray fluorescence spectra along sparse orbital ground tracks at a fixed 150 km (along-track) x 12.5 km (across-track) ground pixel size (Narendranath et al. 2024b). Si is a bulk-silicate baseline element used alongside Al, Fe, and Mg to interpret elemental ratios and estimate feldspar vs. mafic silicate mineral fractions, at finer resolution than LP GRS, within the limits of CLASS's track-based (non-global) coverage.
properties.lri:quality_note: Coverage is 22.05% of the grid (2021-04-01 to 2022-08-31); pixels outside CLASS ground tracks carry no measurement and are stored as NoData rather than interpolated. Si is detectable at any solar activity level, but this release shares an identical footprint mask with Al, Fe, and Mg, bounded by Fe's stricter >~C-class flare requirement.
properties.measurement_depth: tens of microns (X-ray fluorescence escape depth, true surface), much shallower than gamma-ray/neutron spectrometer techniques
properties.processing:lineage: Original Float32 GeoTIFF (ch2_cla_l2_map_si_v1.tif) has its CRS tag reassigned from EPSG:4326 to IAU:30100 via gdal_translate (same numeric lon/lat grid, corrected body reference), NoData explicitly set to 0, and is written as COG with DEFLATE/PREDICTOR=3 compression.
